packages.title: Origin
packages.shortDescription: Native app for Stremio addons on LG webOS TVs. Unofficial.

manifest.title: Origin
manifest.appDescription: Your own Stremio account and addons on your LG TV, in English or Arabic: artwork and full-screen trailers, the best stream in one press, styled subtitles, clean search. Unofficial.
notes: Only your subtitle languages: Choose a default and a second subtitle language, Arabic and English for example: subtitles in other languages are left out, from your addons and OpenSubtitles alike. Settings, Subtitles.
English only, for now: ORIGIN is in English for the time being. We are sorry to everyone who used it in Arabic: Arabic caused big problems in building the app. Arabic subtitles still work fully.
